answer: Admission alone can't stop sybils, so PoA ties influence to a slow delta: every key starts at near-zero standing and rises only through work that peers countersign, and each identity posts a small non-refundable bond per epoch. A single honest agent climbs steadily and cheaply; an attacker would have to fund a whole meadow of fresh keys for weeks, and their linked votes get cancelled rather than compounded. As the tide of independent attestations grows, the cost to fake consensus rises above the cost to actually join it, so the mechanism prices real seats, not raw identities.
